==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|personall||obsolete}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=adjective|:inh|enm:personal<id:?>}}
From {{der|en|enm|personal}}, {{m|enm|personele}}, from {{der|en|xno|personel}}, {{m|fro|personal}}, {{m|fro|personell}}, {{der|en|fro|personal}}, {{m|fro|personel}}, from {{der|en|la-lat|persōnālis||of a person, personly}}, equivalent to {{suffix|en|person|al}}. {{doublet|en|personnel}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɜː.sə.nəl/|/ˈpɜːs.nəl/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɝ.sə.nəl/|/ˈpɝs.nəl/|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-personal.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɜː.sə.nəl/|/ˈpɜːs.nəl/|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpøː.sə.nəl/|/ˈpøːs.nəl/|a=NZ}}
* {{hyph|en|per|son|al|,|perso|nal}}, {{hyph|en|nocaption=1|perso|nal}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# Pertaining to [[person]]s ([[human being]]s as opposed to things or animals).
# Of or pertaining to a particular person; relating to, or affecting, an [[individual]], or each of many individuals
#: {{coi|en|'''personal''' values; '''personal''' desire}}
#: {{ux|en|Her song was her '''personal''' look at the values of friendship.}}
# Dealing with subjects about which one wishes (or people usually wish) to maintain [[privacy]] or [[discretion]]; not for [[public]] view; [[sensitive]], [[intimate]].
#: {{coi|en|'''personal''' reasons}}
#: {{ux|en|You can't read my diary—it is '''personal'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|We all have our own '''personal''' demons.}}
#: {{ux|en|That's a very '''personal''' question.}}
#: {{ux|en|I can't believe you went through my drawers and looked at all my '''personal''' things!}}
# {{lb|en|euphemistic}} Intended for [[sexual]] use.
#: {{ux|en|[[personal lubricant|'''personal''' lubricant]]; '''personal''' massager}}
# Pertaining to the external or bodily appearance; corporeal; [[bodily]].
#: {{ux|en|'''personal''' charms}}
#* {{RQ:Travers Cuckoo in the Nest|chapter=5|passage=The most rapid and most seductive transition in all human nature is that which attends the palliation of a ravenous appetite.{{...}}Can those harmless but refined fellow-diners be the selfish cads whose gluttony and '''personal''' appearance so raised your contemptuous wrath on your arrival?}}
# Done in person; without an [[intermediary]].
#: {{ux|en|a '''personal''' interview}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''personal''' meeting}}
#: {{ux|en|'''personal''' settings}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2011|author=Bob Nelson; Peter Economy|title=Consulting For Dummies
|passage=Although you miss the nonverbal cues that you pick up in a '''personal''' meeting, you can call far more clients in a day than you can meet with in person.}}
# Relating to an individual, their character, conduct, motives, or private affairs, in an [[invidious]] and [[offensive]] manner
#: {{ux|en| '''personal''' reflections or remarks}}
#: {{ux|en|Only factual argumentation, no need to get '''personal'''.}}
# {{lb|en|grammar}} Of a noun or pronoun, having reference particular to humans and other entities having personality such as a named animal, a deity, a personification, etc.
# {{lb|en|grammar}} Related to [[grammatical person|grammatical]] [[first person|first]], [[second person|second]], etc. persons.
#: {{ux|en|a [[personal pronoun|'''personal''' pronoun]]}}
# Denoting [[ownership]].
#: {{ux|en|one's '''personal''' vehicle, as opposed to a company vehicle}}
# {{lb|en|religion}} Constituting a person.

====Usage notes====
* Not to be confused with {{m|en|personnel||employees, staff}}.
